$comment: Boosts (M5.6) = OS Awakenings, numbers from the OS wiki Awakenings page (2026-11). Drafted: 2 shown to everyone at match start (each takes one), then a shared pool after every set picked one at a time in XP order. Each boost can be held once per player.

boosts.name: Agility
boosts.desc: Dashes, blinks and haste +35%. Projectiles fly 55% farther.

boosts.name: Bulk Up
boosts.desc: +300 max Stagger. +1.3 Power per 100 max Stagger.

boosts.name: Sniper
boosts.desc: Hit 25% harder (6.5% on the ball) when you're 600+ away from what you hit.

boosts.name: Sturdy
boosts.desc: +20% size. Your first KO each set is prevented.

boosts.name: Guts
boosts.desc: Up to +80 Power and +50 Cooldown Rate the more Stagger you're missing (full while Staggered).

boosts.name: Moxie
boosts.desc: +20 Power per stack: 1 at set start, +1 per takedown (max 4), -2 when you're KO'd.

boosts.name: Poison Touch
boosts.desc: Hits burn 10% of the target's max Stagger over 3.5 s (2.5% for LIGHT hits).

boosts.name: Leftovers
boosts.desc: Hitting an enemy heals 7.5% of your max Stagger (2% for LIGHT) and deals 40% of that to them.

boosts.name: Speed Boost
boosts.desc: Every 2 s without being hit: +4 Power and +2% speed, up to +24 and +12%. Getting hit resets it.

boosts.name: Run Away
boosts.desc: Within 250 of the arena edge: +40% speed but 0 Power.

boosts.name: Mega Launcher
boosts.desc: Projectiles fly 70% farther and hit 17.5% harder (4.5% on the ball).

boosts.name: Tough Claws
boosts.desc: Your moves hit players 15% harder (4% on the ball).

boosts.name: Sheer Force
boosts.desc: Your special hits 35% harder (8% on the ball) and heals 35% more.

boosts.name: Light Clay
boosts.desc: Walls last 60% longer and are 35% bigger.

boosts.name: Swords Dance
boosts.desc: SPARK: +8 Power, +16 more for every other Spark you hold.

boosts.name: Rock Polish
boosts.desc: SPARK: +4% speed, +3% more for every other Spark you hold.

boosts.name: Calm Mind
boosts.desc: SPARK: +7 Cooldown Rate, +6 more for every other Spark you hold.
